appEssentials.title: {{appName}} Essentials
appEssentials.description: Our top recommendations for every listener

welcome.title: Welcome to {{appName}}
welcome.subtitle: A New Chapter
welcome.description: A beautiful Mushaf, ayah highlighting, word-by-word translation, adhkar, ambient sounds, and so much more.

mushaf.title: The Mushaf
mushaf.description: A dedicated reading screen with the full Uthmani script, beautiful tajweed coloring, and an immersive reading mode.

highlighting.title: Follow Along
highlighting.description: Each ayah highlights in sync with the recitation so you never lose your place. Available for most of your favorite reciters, and coming to all reciters soon.

memorize.title: Listen to Memorize
memorize.description: Repeat a single ayah, play a range of verses, or loop an entire page. Perfect for hifdh and review.

uploads.title: Personal Recitations
uploads.description: Import your own audio recordings, tag them with surah and reciter metadata, and organize your personal collection.

ambient.title: Ambient Sounds
ambient.description: Layer calming nature soundscapes like rain, ocean, forest, and more over your recitation for a focused experience.

verseInteractions.title: Verse Interactions
verseInteractions.description: Bookmark, highlight, take notes, copy, and share any verse. Your annotations sync across the app.

adhkar.title: Adhkar (Remembrance)
adhkar.description: The complete Hisnul Muslim collection with audio playback, Play All mode, and saved favorites.

wbw.title: Word by Word
wbw.description: Tap any word to see its meaning, transliteration, and grammar — right in the mushaf or player.

translations.title: Translations & Tafseer
translations.description: Browse dozens of translations and scholarly commentaries in multiple languages, all downloadable for offline use.

themes.title: Thematic Highlighting
themes.description: Verses are color-coded by theme so you can see the structure and topics of each surah at a glance.

indopak.title: IndoPak Script
indopak.description: Switch to the IndoPak Nastaliq script in the mushaf for the style used across South Asia.

downloads.title: Offline Downloads
downloads.description: Download individual surahs or entire playlists so you can listen without an internet connection.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.description: Create custom playlists, reorder tracks, and build your own listening routines.
